text:
maria: Quick pulse — trying to map evidence gating for next SOC2 sprint. I sketched a gating map and a CR queue for auditlog/KMS PRs. Need owners for each gate + CR review volunteers. TL;DR: gating nodes = ingest, retention, rotation, access-controls, HSM-attestation. Can owners confirm?
aj: I can own ingest gating (auditlog pipeline). I'll do a short doc + checklist. ETA EOD Wed.
ken: Rotation gating — I can take rotation playbook but need someone from security to sign off on KMS ACLs.
olivia: I'll sign off on KMS ACLs. Can someone add access-control test vectors to the checklist? Example: "test rotation without key access".
dave: CR queue — we have 3 open PRs blocking: #4212 (auditlog backfill), #4270 (keystore bind), #4300 (hsm-stub). Can reviewers please ping.
maria: Thanks. @ai-review-bot please list PRs labeled "soc2".
ai-review-bot: Found 3 PRs: #4212, #4270, #4300. Tentative reviewers: @aj, @ken, @dave. Command to assign:
```
/pr-review assign --prs 4212,4270,4300 --reviewers @aj,@ken,@dave
```
aj: Assigned. I'll pick up #4212 tomorrow morning. @olivia would you do quick security review on #4212 once I update logs?
olivia: yep. Also, small ask: include evidence artifact path in PR description: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/<pr-number>
ken: For HSM attestation gate, we need to schedule a smoke test window with vendor. I can coordinate. Dates? next Tue-Wed preferred.
maria: noted. @julia FYI — vendor window might affect feature freeze.
julia: OK, will shift freeze by 48h if needed. Please update calendar.
dave: Quick FYI: retention gating check failing on staging due to retention job TTL bug. I'll file fix PR today #4321.
aj: +1 on that. Also adding test snippet:
```
# verify auditlog retention
aws s3 ls s3://audit-staging | grep 2025-
```
olivia: policy question — do we treat keystore key rotation logs as evidentiary? If yes, include rotation logs in retention plan.
maria: yes, treat rotation logs as evidence. Add to checklist.
sam: Added 'evidence path' and 'reviewer' columns to the gating map sheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 (please fill your rows)
maria: Action items recap: aj -> #4212, ken -> rotation + vendor window, dave -> fix retention PR #4321, olivia -> security signoffs and add test vectors, sam -> update gating map. I'll follow up in next standup. :thumbsup:
